_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Draft compiled 2026-09-26. This is the five-defendant Groblersdal methamphetamine-laboratory case, not a verified Sinaloa chapter. SAPS used tentative language (“appear to be”) about a Mexican syndicate, which does not justify individual affiliation or an inter-network link. Names follow the SAPS briefing; SABC has several order/spelling variants, recorded in claim notes. All charges are allegations. No conviction after the cited 2025 procedural reports was found during the bounded 2026 search; later disposition is unknown. Country markers indicate only alleged historical activity in South Africa; Mexican nationality does not establish operations in Mexico. No co-defendant pairwise edges, exact site details, routes, or unlicensed photos are included.
